id.description: Task slug, also its directory name under tasks/.

repo_fixture.description: Path (relative to this task.json) or git ref to the starting repo state. A plain path is materialized by copy; a ref of the form 'git:<url>#<sha>' is materialized by clone+checkout.

prompt.description: The instruction handed to the agent. Must not itself contain the planted-memory content — the task must be solvable without it.

check_cmd.description: Shell command run from the materialized workdir after the agent finishes. Exit code 0 = pass. Must be deterministic and side-effect-free to rerun.

planted_memories.description: Memories a working memory system could have retained from a prior session on this repo. Each one shortens the path to the fix; none is required — an agent with no memory access must still be able to pass by reading the fixture and reasoning.

expected_tokens_budget.description: Rough token budget for a memory-off solve; used only to flag outlier runs, not to score.
